//go:build e2e && svc_k8s_runner

package tests

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	runnerv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/runner/v1"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/resource"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
)

// The e2e-device flavor and its fake extended resource come from
// .github/e2e/device-flavor.py. No device plugin backs it, so this proves the
// Pod the runner builds for a device flavor schedules and runs with the group,
// and that a sized flavor without devices gets neither -- not /dev/kvm.
func TestNativeFlavorDevices(t *testing.T) {
	const fakeDevice corev1.ResourceName = "e2e.agyn.dev/fake-device"
	client := newK8sRunnerClient(t)
	pods := kubeClientset(t).CoreV1().Pods("agyn-workloads")

	for _, flavor := range []string{"e2e-device", "ram-4gb"} {
		t.Run(flavor, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := testContext(t)
			t.Cleanup(cancel)
			req := sleepWorkloadRequest()
			req.Flavor = flavor
			started := startWorkloadWithCleanup(t, ctx, client, req)
			waitRunning(t, ctx, client, started.GetId())

			pod, err := pods.Get(ctx, podNameFromID(started.GetId()), metav1.GetOptions{})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			main := pod.Spec.Containers[0]
			result := collectExecOutput(t, ctx, client, &runnerv1.ExecStartRequest{
				TargetId: started.GetContainers().GetMain(), CommandArgv: []string{"id", "-G"},
			})
			require.NotNil(t, result.exit)
			require.Equal(t, int32(0), result.exit.GetExitCode())
			groups := strings.Fields(result.stdout)

			if flavor != "e2e-device" {
				require.NotContains(t, main.Resources.Requests, fakeDevice)
				require.NotContains(t, main.Resources.Limits, fakeDevice)
				require.NotContains(t, groups, "4242")
				return
			}
			for name, list := range map[string]corev1.ResourceList{"requests": main.Resources.Requests, "limits": main.Resources.Limits} {
				got, ok := list[fakeDevice]
				require.Truef(t, ok && got.Cmp(resource.MustParse("1")) == 0, "main %s = %v", name, list)
			}
			require.NotNil(t, pod.Spec.SecurityContext)
			require.Equal(t, []int64{4242}, pod.Spec.SecurityContext.SupplementalGroups)
			require.Contains(t, groups, "4242", "main process groups: %q", result.stdout)
		})
	}
}
